change_summary: Delegate natural user outcomes and complete context without inventing Corvio's taxonomy or artifact plan, and return canonical role-aware Question artifact URLs that hosts can use without guessing from node IDs.

canonical_skill.note: The internal shared Skill teaches outcome delegation, explicit user-constraint preservation, terminal artifact roles, and canonical URL consumption as release 1.7.3.

server_contract.note: Contract 2026-09-09.7 aligns natural semantic delegation with role-aware artifact receipts and canonical Page URLs.

package_manifests.note: Plugin and Skill manifests advance together to 1.7.3 and advertise the 2026-09-09.7 collaboration contract.

workspace_cli.note: CLI beta.23 exposes the same outcome-delegation and canonical-artifact guidance; Admin remains version-locked to the shared release train.

help_center.note: English, Simplified Chinese, and Traditional Chinese MCP Help now explain natural delegation, terminal roles, and verbatim artifact URLs.

package_setup.note: OAuth endpoints, scopes, installation commands, and session-refresh ownership do not change.

harness_and_mainline.note: The mainline records the production first-bad boundary and adds a real natural two-context Work Model regression.

external_marketplaces.note: Anthropic, WorkBuddy, and other account-owned listing or fresh-host acceptance remains pending until external receipts exist.

release_evidence.note: Regression evidence covers canonical URL identity, Project/Page role separation, host guidance parity, and trigger-transfer-countercase behavior.
